headline: RBZ Jewellers confirms 100 percent demat shareholding for Q2 FY27
hook: Compliance check completed ahead of schedule
summary: RBZ Jewellers has confirmed that its entire shareholding is held in dematerialized form, making a specific SEBI rule inapplicable for the second quarter of financial year 2027. The company made this regulatory disclosure to ensure transparency regarding its shareholding structure. Retail investors holding shares in the company can note the fully dematerialized status, which ensures smooth electronic trading. The compliance status removes uncertainty regarding procedural regulatory hurdles for the quarter.
why_it_matters: Procedural compliance confirmed with no direct impact on stock price.
